validation_results.details: All 25 physical pages retain page-aware text and nonblank rendered pixels. The complete 25-page paper was read in order rather than keyword-skimmed: Summary; background, restatement, work plan, assumptions, and notation; elevation-volume fitting; basin transport, hydropower, electricity-loss, water-loss, and maintenance layers; dynamic supply and lake-split results; three-objective state-sector allocation and guarantee scenarios; Mexico extension; three sensitivity studies; strengths and weaknesses; references; and the manager article. Printed notation, units, coefficients, provenance gaps, algorithm stops, and claim boundaries were preserved rather than silently repaired.

379 source-anchored language units cover all 13 normalized chapters and all 25 source sections. Nine repeated B-language patterns retain rhetorical function, information order, slots, variants, boundary, disposition, and two unrelated original instantiations; occurrences are 28, 33, 18, 147, 17, 32, 71, 15, and 18 in catalog order. Language remains the largest evidence dimension by a wide margin.

379/379 language units passed the complete extracted-source anti-copy audit. Every unit has two unrelated instantiations; there are zero full-clause matches, zero unique eight-word matches, zero source-fact leaks, and the maximum shared content run is two against the eight-word failure threshold.

Positive organization evidence retains 12 paper-card writing-logic artifacts, 13 normalized five-move chapter contracts spanning 25 source sections, an eight-stage global chain, and 16 main argument chains. The reusable handoff is drought framing -> typed assumptions and data provenance -> storage fit -> physical transport and loss accounting -> maintenance and repeated supply -> social-economic-environmental allocation -> Mexico and sensitivity extensions -> evidence-bounded management communication.

Twenty-four typed model units retain all 29 visually checked equations, 24 explicit algorithms or procedures, 24 model-level validation records, and 30 typed dependency edges. The chain preserves polynomial storage fitting, network transport, hydropower and two loss channels, maintenance-state updates, daily supply and reservoir splitting, three-objective allocation with constraints and weights, guarantee scenarios, logistic Mexico scaling, demand and technology sensitivity, conservation response, and manager-facing decision translation.

The audit preserves 21 important visual dispositions: ten figures, seven tables, and four algorithm or other objects. It records 22 final-pass G7 warnings and 15 equation-linked formula warnings only after positive language, organization, model, result, and visual learning. Positive reusable language is 379 versus 22 weakness observations, so error hunting did not replace learning.

The paper card, 512 observations, 23 cumulative B rules, extraction manifest, language record, model record, complete 25-page visual review, and the full 151-paper observation corpus cross-validate with no identity, page, rule, count, or artifact mismatch.
